Niacinamide

Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) is one of the most studied and proven actives in skincare. It works by inhibiting melanin transfer to the skin's surface - meaning dark spots, sun damage, and post-acne marks gradually fade with consistent use. But it doesn't stop there: Niacinamide strengthens the skin barrier, reduces pore appearance, and regulates oil production. It's effective across all skin types without irritation, which is why dermatologists recommend it as a foundational ingredient. In our Toner Pads, it's dosed at clinical concentration so every swipe delivers real results - not just a label claim.

Peptides

Peptides are short chains of amino acids that act as messengers to your skin cells. When applied topically, they signal your body to ramp up collagen and elastin production - the two proteins responsible for keeping skin firm, bouncy, and resilient. As we age, collagen production drops roughly 1% per year, leading to fine lines and sagging. Peptides help counteract that decline at the cellular level. Unlike retinol, peptides deliver firming benefits without irritation or sensitivity, making them safe for daily use on all skin types. Our formula uses targeted peptide complexes that penetrate effectively through the toner pad delivery system.

Snail Mucin

Snail Mucin is a K-Beauty staple - and for good reason. It's a naturally occurring complex of glycoproteins, hyaluronic acid, glycolic acid, and zinc, which together deliver intense hydration while supporting skin repair. It helps heal micro-damage from environmental stressors and exfoliation, reduces redness, and leaves skin with a dewy, plumped finish. Clinical studies show snail mucin improves skin hydration by up to 25% within hours of application. It's especially effective when paired with exfoliating actives (like in our Toner Pads) because it soothes and replenishes the skin immediately after treatment.

Centella Asiatica

Known as "Cica" in Korean skincare, Centella Asiatica has been used for centuries in traditional medicine for wound healing. Its active compounds - madecassoside, asiaticoside, and asiatic acid - reduce inflammation, stimulate collagen synthesis, and strengthen the skin barrier. For anyone dealing with redness, sensitivity, or irritation from environmental stress, Centella provides immediate calming relief. It's the reason our Toner Pads can deliver powerful actives like Vitamin C and Niacinamide without causing irritation — Centella balances the formula so your skin gets the benefits without the burn.

Vitamin C Derivative

Our Toner Pads use a stabilized Vitamin C derivative (3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid) - not pure ascorbic acid, which degrades quickly and can irritate skin. This advanced form converts to active Vitamin C once absorbed, delivering the same powerful antioxidant benefits without instability or stinging. It neutralizes free radicals from UV exposure and pollution, stimulates collagen production, and brightens dull, uneven skin over time. The stabilized form also means the product stays effective from the first pad to the last - no oxidation, no loss of potency. It's clinical-grade protection that works with your skin, not against it.

Hyaluronic Acid Complex

Not all Hyaluronic Acid is created equal. Most products use a single molecular weight, which only hydrates at one depth. Our Toner Pads use a multi-weight Hyaluronic Acid complex - combining high, medium, and low molecular weights - so moisture is delivered and locked in at every layer of the skin. The larger molecules form a hydrating barrier on the surface, while the smaller molecules penetrate deeper to plump from within. The result is hydration that lasts all day, not just the first hour. Well-hydrated skin also absorbs other actives more effectively, which means every ingredient in the formula works harder.

Alpha-Arbutin

Alpha-Arbutin is one of the most effective and gentlest brightening ingredients available. It works by inhibiting tyrosinase - the enzyme responsible for melanin production - which means it fades existing dark spots, sun damage, and hyperpigmentation while preventing new spots from forming. Unlike hydroquinone (which can cause rebound darkening and irritation), Alpha-Arbutin delivers comparable brightening results with zero sensitization risk. It's safe for all skin tones and types, including sensitive skin. Combined with Niacinamide and Vitamin C in our Toner Pads, it creates a triple-action brightening system that targets discoloration from multiple pathways simultaneously.

Licorice Root Extract

Licorice Root Extract (Glycyrrhiza Glabra) is a powerhouse brightening and anti-inflammatory ingredient backed by decades of dermatological research. Its key active compound — Glabridin — inhibits tyrosinase activity and blocks UV-induced melanin production, making it one of the most effective natural brightening agents available. But unlike many brightening actives, Licorice Root simultaneously calms inflammation and reduces redness, so it treats discoloration without aggravating the skin conditions that cause it. Studies show Glabridin can reduce melanin production by up to 50% at targeted concentrations. It also contains Liquiritin, which disperses existing melanin deposits — meaning it fades the spots you already have, not just the ones forming. In our Toner Pads, Licorice Root Extract works in concert with Alpha-Arbutin, Niacinamide, and Vitamin C to create a multi-pathway brightening system where each ingredient attacks hyperpigmentation through a different mechanism. NAD+

NAD+ (Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide) is the cornerstone of our Anti-Aging Moisturizing Cream. This coenzyme exists in every cell of your body and is essential for energy production, DNA repair, and cellular renewal. By age 50, your NAD+ levels have dropped by nearly half - and your skin shows it: slower healing, loss of firmness, and deepening lines. By delivering NAD+ topically, this cream helps restore the cellular machinery your skin needs to function like it did years ago. Cells turn over faster, produce more collagen, and repair damage more efficiently. This is anti-aging that works at the source - not just the surface.

5-Layer Hyaluronic Acid

Most moisturizers use one or two types of Hyaluronic Acid. Our cream uses five distinct molecular weights - from ultra-low to high - creating a hydration system that works at every layer of the skin simultaneously. The largest molecules form a moisture-sealing barrier on the surface. Mid-weight molecules plump the middle layers. And the smallest molecules penetrate deep to hydrate from within, where fine lines actually form. The result is hydration that doesn't just sit on top and evaporate - it builds volume, smooths texture, and lasts through the entire day. Your skin stays plump, dewy, and resilient from morning to night.

Cassia Angustifolia Seed Polysaccharide

Derived from the seeds of the Cassia Angustifolia plant, this polysaccharide is often called "botanical hyaluronic acid" for its exceptional moisture-binding ability. But it does more than hydrate - it forms a breathable, protective film on the skin that soothes irritation, reduces redness, and helps rebalance stressed or overworked skin. It's particularly effective for skin that's been exposed to environmental aggressors like pollution, dry air, or temperature changes. Unlike synthetic soothing agents, this plant-derived ingredient works with your skin's biology, delivering comfort without clogging pores or leaving residue.

Ferulic Acid

Ferulic Acid is a plant-derived antioxidant that's been clinically shown to double the photoprotective power of Vitamins C and E when combined. In our cream, it works as a force multiplier - boosting the effectiveness of every brightening and protective ingredient in the formula. On its own, Ferulic Acid neutralizes free radicals generated by UV exposure and pollution, preventing the oxidative stress that accelerates fine lines, dark spots, and loss of firmness. It also helps stabilize the Vitamin C derivative in our formula, ensuring consistent potency over the life of the product.

Sunflower Seed Wax

Sunflower Seed Wax is a plant-derived occlusive that acts as the final seal in our moisturizer's hydration system. After the Hyaluronic Acid complex hydrates, the Ceramides rebuild the barrier, and the Shea Butter nourishes - Sunflower Seed Wax locks everything in place. It forms a lightweight, breathable film that prevents transepidermal water loss without suffocating the skin. It also contains natural fatty acids and Vitamin E that contribute their own nourishing and protective benefits. Think of it as the final layer of defense that ensures every active ingredient stays where it needs to be - working in your skin, not evaporating off it.

Shea Butter

Shea Butter has been used for centuries in skincare for good reason. It's exceptionally rich in fatty acids (oleic, stearic, linoleic) and vitamins A and E, which nourish and soften skin while creating a protective layer against moisture loss. But unlike heavier occlusives that can feel greasy or clog pores, our formula uses refined Shea Butter that absorbs cleanly into the skin. It delivers deep, lasting nourishment - especially important for areas prone to dryness like the neck, chest, and hands. It also works synergistically with Ceramide NP to rebuild and protect the skin barrier from both sides.

Niacinamide

Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) is one of the most studied and proven actives in skincare. It works by inhibiting melanin transfer to the skin's surface - meaning dark spots, sun damage, and post-acne marks gradually fade with consistent use. But it doesn't stop there: Niacinamide strengthens the skin barrier, reduces pore appearance, and regulates oil production. It's effective across all skin types without irritation, which is why dermatologists recommend it as a foundational ingredient. In our Toner Pads, it's dosed at clinical concentration so every swipe delivers real results - not just a label claim.

Vitamin C Derivative

Our Toner Pads use a stabilized Vitamin C derivative (3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid) - not pure ascorbic acid, which degrades quickly and can irritate skin. This advanced form converts to active Vitamin C once absorbed, delivering the same powerful antioxidant benefits without instability or stinging. It neutralizes free radicals from UV exposure and pollution, stimulates collagen production, and brightens dull, uneven skin over time. The stabilized form also means the product stays effective from the first pad to the last - no oxidation, no loss of potency. It's clinical-grade protection that works with your skin, not against it.

Ceramide NP

Ceramides make up over 50% of your skin's natural barrier - the protective layer that keeps moisture in and irritants out. As we age, ceramide levels decline, leading to dryness, sensitivity, and increased vulnerability to environmental damage. Ceramide NP is bioidentical to the ceramides naturally found in human skin, meaning it integrates seamlessly into your existing barrier structure. It doesn't just coat the surface — it fills in the gaps between skin cells, restoring the barrier's integrity at a structural level. The result is skin that holds moisture longer, resists irritation better, and feels fundamentally stronger.
